blind.description: A stylized shock or stook formed of four sheaves of harvested grain or wheat leaning inward against one another in a teepee arrangement. Each sheaf features a flared, ribbed straw skirt at the base, two rope bands tied around the stalk section, and a dense cluster of grain kernels/ears at the top. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with an orange-ochre dried straw appearance.
blind.from_above: Resembles a four-armed cross or four-petaled flower, with four flared fan-like skirts radiating outward and four textured grain heads clustered tightly at the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% of the figure's height (around 2.3 to 2.6 feet tall) and roughly 2.5 feet wide across its base.

notes: gemini note: slightly squatter than catalog proportions
